title: Jobs+ Harvest Addon
description: Implements (Serilum's) Tree harvester to the Jobs+ Lumberjack job.
body:
A mod that implements (Serilum's) Tree harvester to the Jobs+ Lumberjack job.

The Tree harvester wont work unless unlocked in the lumberjack power-ups tree.
You need to be crouching(shifting) to harvest an tree.
